steps.title: Gather Feathers
steps.hints: First run craft_plan on 'Stone Arrow' to see the exact inputs, then gather what it lists. Feathers likely come from birds or from the ground. Gather any sticks, logs or stones the recipe names. Stay away from the rats until he is armed.

steps.title: Craft Stone Arrows at a Fletching Bench
steps.hints: Use buildables to see whether a Fletching Bench can be built and what it needs. Build one if the materials are affordable, otherwise find an existing one. Then craft Stone Arrow. If Stone Arrow can't be made, try Fang Arrow or ask for help.

steps.title: Equip bow and shoot Giant Rats
steps.hints: Equip the Oak Shortbow and the arrows, then attack the Giant Rats by id from range. The rats are low power, so this is low risk. Swap back to the Bronze Sword if the arrows run out.

events.description: Train Ranged (level 1, the lowest skill) by getting basic arrows for the Oak Shortbow he already carries, then shooting the nearby Giant Rats.
events.explanation: Ranged is 1 while every other skill is 10, and he already has an Oak Shortbow. The only missing piece is ammo. Bronze arrows need a furnace, a smith merchant and chits, which is too much for now. The wiki lists Stone Arrow as the weakest arrow, so it is probably the cheapest. I did not confirm its recipe or where to get feathers. So the first steps are to collect feathers and craft stone arrows, and the controller should check the recipe with craft_plan and buildables first. Kills with the bow come after that.
